main:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "For each test case, reads an r by c character grid and exhaustively enumerates non-empty cell subsets to find the largest connected subset for which there exists a pivot point placing every selected cell character into at most one distinct character per quadrant, then prints that size." main]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> args </REF>: String[] "Command-line arguments passed to the main method; not used in the method body."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize br as a BufferedReader over System.in and pw as a PrintWriter over System.out. RESULT br, pw]
            [COMMAND Read the number of test cases qq by calling readInt(). RESULT qq]
            [COMMAND For each test case casenum from 1 to qq inclusive, write 'Case #' + casenum + ': ' to pw. RESULT casenum]
            [COMMAND Read integers r = readInt() and c = readInt(), and initialize ret = 1. RESULT r, c, ret]
            [COMMAND Read the character grid g of size r by c: for each row i from 0 to r-1, read String s = nextToken(), then for each column j from 0 to c-1 set g[i][j] = s.charAt(j). RESULT g]
            [COMMAND Iterate mask starting at 1 and continuing while mask < (1 << (r*c)), incrementing mask by 1 after each iteration. RESULT mask]
            [COMMAND If Integer.bitCount(mask) <= ret, skip this mask and continue to the next mask. RESULT result]
            [COMMAND Initialize t = mask, allocate par = new int[r*c], set par[i] = i for every i, and allocate boolean use matrix of size r by c. RESULT t, par, use]
            [COMMAND Extract mask bits into use in row-major order: for each row i and column j, set use[i][j] = true when (t & 1) != 0 and shift t right by one for each cell. RESULT use]
            [COMMAND Set numNeed = Integer.bitCount(mask) - 1. RESULT numNeed]
            [COMMAND For each selected cell (i,j), if i+1 < r and use[i+1][j] is true and merge(i*c+j, (i+1)*c+j) returns true, decrement numNeed; also, if j+1 < c and use[i][j+1] is true and merge(i*c+j, i*c+j+1) returns true, decrement numNeed. RESULT numNeed]
            [COMMAND If numNeed != 0, skip this mask because the selected cells are not connected. RESULT result]
            [COMMAND Set valid = false, then for each pivot position (i,j) while valid is false, create four empty HashSet<Character> quadrant sets, set good = true, and inspect selected cells while good remains true. RESULT valid, good, all]
            [COMMAND For each selected cell (x,y) during the pivot check, compute idx = 0, set bit 2 if x > i, set bit 1 if y < j, add g[x][y] to all[idx], and set good = (all[idx].size() < 2). RESULT idx, all]
            [COMMAND After the x,y loops for a pivot, set valid = good; stop early if valid becomes true during the pivot loops. RESULT valid]
            [COMMAND If valid is false, skip this mask because no pivot satisfies the quadrant character constraint. RESULT result]
            [COMMAND If the mask passes the connectivity and validity checks, update ret = Integer.bitCount(mask). RESULT ret]
            [COMMAND After all masks have been processed for the current test case, write ret to pw using pw.println(ret). RESULT result]
            [COMMAND After all test cases have been processed, close pw. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [EXCEPTION_FLOW: readInt(), nextToken(), or another operation in the method throws a checked exception (the method signature declares throws Exception).]
        [LOG "I/O or input-parsing failure while reading test case data."]
        [THROW Exception "Propagate the thrown exception because the method signature declares throws Exception."]
    [END_EXCEPTION_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
